sources.title: Amazon.com Associates Program Operating Agreement
sources.key_rule: Section 1 defines Special Links using Amazon-provided tagged formats. Section 5 requires clear and prominent identification on the Site stating verbatim: "As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases." Section 5 also prohibits misrepresenting the relationship or implying Amazon endorsement.

sources.title: Amazon.com Associates Program Policies (Commission Income Statement & Participation Requirements)
sources.key_rule: Participation Requirements §2(a)-(b) require including your assigned Associates ID (XXXXX-##) in Special Links, prohibit inaccurate/overbroad claims, and forbid displaying price or availability unless served directly by Amazon or obtained via Creators API / PA API. §6(t) forbids displaying Amazon customer reviews or star ratings except via Creators API / PA API. §6(w) forbids link shorteners that obscure linking to an Amazon Site. §6(y) forbids price tracking or price alerting functionality unless agreed by Amazon. Commission Income Statement §2(e)/(g) excludes Redirecting Links and improperly formatted links.

sources.title: What is an ASIN? Amazon Standard Identification Numbers, explained
sources.key_rule: Defines ASIN verbatim as a "unique 10-character alphanumeric code assigned to every product listed in the Amazon store" and shows that it appears after /dp/ in Amazon product URLs. Confirms that 9-character link.amazon path slugs are short-link tokens, not 10-character ASINs.

sources.title: FTC's Endorsement Guides: What People Are Asking
sources.key_rule: Affiliate marketers must disclose their material financial connection clearly and conspicuously near recommendations. "Paid link" adjacent to a link is adequate, whereas "affiliate link", "commissionable link", a "buy now" button, or a standalone "DISCLOSURE" hyperlink/button is not sufficient on its own.

sources.title: 16 CFR Part 255 — Guides Concerning Use of Endorsements and Testimonials in Advertising
sources.publisher: Electronic Code of Federal Regulations (eCFR / FTC)
sources.document_date: 88 FR 48102 (up to date as of November 18, 2026)
sources.key_rule: 16 CFR §255.1 requires endorsements to reflect honest opinions and substantiated representations; §255.5 requires clear and conspicuous disclosure of unexpected material connections between an endorser/marketer and seller.

sources.title: Qualify your outbound links to Google (rel="sponsored")
sources.key_rule: Paid and affiliate links should be marked with rel="sponsored" (combinable with space-separated values such as rel="sponsored nofollow").

sources.title: Performance report (Search results): Overview and basic setup
sources.key_rule: Defines first-party Google Search metrics (Clicks, Impressions, CTR, Average position) grouped by Queries and Pages so future editorial guides can be selected from measured reader queries rather than guesswork.

sources.title: What is GitHub Pages?
sources.key_rule: GitHub Pages hosts static HTML, CSS, and JS project sites under http(s)://<owner>.github.io/<repositoryname> and logs visitor IP addresses for security purposes; dynamic first-party analytics collection requires a separate self-hosted runtime.
